name: ddi-inform
description: DDI inForm ERP (Infragistics on WinForms, UniVerse backend). Tabbed MDI workspace in the main window: Customer Master, Sales Order Entry, Purchase Order Entry, Price Change, ... Written after the first real run (2026-11-18), revised after the measured run of 2026-11-19.
note: On this toolkit button presses come from inference (the control under the pointer or the focus when a window, tab or message changes; the buttons report nothing themselves) and the values the program fills in come from re-reads of the document after each typed value or press (its grid cells and bound editors report no change). The data lives on a UniVerse server: ProgramData\DDISYSTEM\Inform\installedapplication.config names the host (HostName) and account (AccountPath). Tables and rules need a read-only UniVerse ODBC login from the vendor, a nightly export drop folder, or UVSQL logging on the server.
